title: Comments
concept: Comments are notes in your code that the compiler ignores — they're for humans, not computers.
why: Code is read more than it's written. Comments explain the 'why' behind your code to your future self and teammates.
tips: `//` comments out the rest of the line
`/* */` can span multiple lines — great for longer notes
Comments don't affect how your program runs at all
Use TODO comments to track what you still need to do
common_mistakes: Forgetting to close a `/* */` comment — everything after it gets commented out!
Nesting `/* */` comments — `/* /* */ */` doesn't work as expected
Writing comments that just repeat the code: `// add 1 to x` for `x = x + 1`
